rules: Exact sibling source/raw joins must remain valid.
Deadline/supervisor failure is INCOMPLETE regardless of stdout.
Nonzero raw output is retained then classified at actual offending operation with expected type/quantity authority.
Unrelated error cannot count as confinement; preserve and repair source only under new admitted plan.

cases.label: negative-undeclared-query
cases.offending: F.required instantiated with I.Frame<A.Schema,A.Store,A.Resource,U32> from I.plan_caps, while API.each expects ReadQuery<H,...>.
cases.expectedCategory: type mismatch between nominal concrete I.Frame and universally quantified H in read grant; intended error must point to concrete grant expression, not missing symbol/import/parser/effect.
cases.sourceText:
import Base
import ../query-api.bend as API
import ../cardinality-workshop.bend as F
import ../../bend-candidate/consumer.bend as A
import ../../bend-candidate/inspect.bend as I
import ../../bend-candidate/query.bend as Q
# Trusted concrete setup cannot satisfy a universally quantified callback owner.
def bad(~H:Type,owner:H) -> H & List<&2,Q.Row<A.Schema,List<&2,U32>>>:
  API.each(~H,~A.Schema,~List<&2,U32>,~F.required(~I.Frame<A.Schema,A.Store,A.Resource,U32>,I.plan_caps(~A.Schema,~A.Store,~A.Resource,~U32,~F.Ops,F.plan())),owner)

cases.label: negative-cross-owner-query
cases.offending: ReadQuery<H,...> with owner:Other passed as the owner argument expected H.
cases.expectedCategory: type mismatch Other versus H at API.each owner argument; not missing symbol/import/parser/effect.
cases.sourceText:
import Base
import ../query-api.bend as API
import ../cardinality-workshop.bend as F
import ../../bend-candidate/consumer.bend as A
import ../../bend-candidate/query.bend as Q
# A declaration tied to one universally quantified owner cannot consume another.
def bad(~H:Type,~Other:Type,~caps:F.Reads<H>,owner:Other) -> Other & List<&2,Q.Row<A.Schema,List<&2,U32>>>:
  API.each(~H,~A.Schema,~List<&2,U32>,~F.required(~H,caps),owner)

cases.expectedCategory: type mismatch ReadQuery versus Cap.ValueWrite at write grant; not missing symbol/import/parser/effect.

import Base
import ../../../../src/ecs/capabilities.bend as Cap
# A condition consumer receives an opaque owner and read-only declaration grant.
def bad(~H:Type,~read:Cap.ValueRead<H,List<&2,U32>>,owner:H) -> H:
  Cap.value_set(~H,~List<&2,U32>,~List<&2,U32>,~read,owner,[])

cases.expectedCategory: quantity/linear duplication error at owner binder/use; not generic result type mismatch or parser error.
